transcript:
MARTIN (anxious): Come on David...

[SFX: cellphone dialing]

DAVID (answering machine): You've reached David Scott. I can't make it to the phone right now, so please leave a message.

[SFX: of landline ringing, loudly, interrupting the early part of voicemail greeting. The voicemail picks up and starts playing its greeting, exactly as per the start of act 1. Martin immediately lifts the receiver].


DAVID (Laughing): Sorry, I dropped the phone.

MARTIN: Thought the dark got ya.

DAVID (Unimpressed): Funny guy.

MARTIN: Where are you now?

DAVID: A hallway... I think it leads into the east wing.

MARTIN: What’s the banging?

DAVID: Wind slamming the cell doors. 

MARTIN: Glad you’re alive.

DAVID: Alive to die another day, my man. Okay. You still set up? I'm ready when you are.
